title: Ratchet & Clank: A Crack in Time 1.20
note: Input of tools/spu/lift_igjobs.py: Insomniac's igPm job kernel and the job blobs the ig instance runs (the RE notes sections 31-33). The kernel is GET by the interpreted igPm loader (pc 0xB14, 0x510 bytes to LS 0x3F580, entry 0x3F5A0); its code ends at 0x3F9F8 (the job header buffer is at 0x3FA00, outside the span). Jobs: every code EA the kernel GETs to LS 0x100 in acit-igj (RC_SPU_GETLOG, kernel pc 0x3F868); all are format A (header quad at +0x10 gives LS dest, size and entry; an entry stub `ila $r11,0; stqd $r3,0x20($r11)` sits at each decoded entry). Overlays: job 0x00B8A500 GETs two code blobs with a relative header (four `ila $r2`, word +0x10 = 0x10) to fixed LS addresses and calls LS + word + 0x20 (its code 0x0FF30..0x0FF48), so lsa/size/entry are given. Image ids 51 (kernel) and 60+ (jobs, overlays) are unused by ACiT's other lifts (2, 30, 200, 201).
